"'''Blue Five'''" was a [[Gender|female]] [[Mirialan]] pilot for the [[Resistance Starfighter Corps]]' [[Blue Squadron (Resistance)|Blue Squadron]], she helmed a [[T-70 X-wing starfighter]]. On her final mission, she flew as part of a wing guard for a [[Resistance]] recruitment transport leaving from [[Black Spire Outpost]] on [[Batuu]] for the primary Resistance base.

==Biography==
Blue Five joined the Resistance before [[34 ABY]] and flew as a starfighter pilot as a part of Blue Squadron under [[Captain]] [[Temmin Wexley]].<ref name="Rise" /><ref name="Flight Log">''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]''</ref>
When the [[First Order]] attacked the Resistance base on [[D'Qar]] in 34 ABY, Blue Five was away on a mission and one of the few surviving members of Blue Squadron; [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]]'s bombing run killed most of the squadron before they could deploy.<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>

===Battle of Batuu===
{{Quote|Red Two, Blue Five, keep it tight now. Let's get ready to make that jump to lightspeed on my mark.|Poe Dameron|<ref name="Rise" />}}
Under orders from [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa Solo]] to grow the Resistance, Blue Five joined other revolutionaries on Batuu a few months later to regroup and rebuild.<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] to [[34 ABY]] with ''[[Galaxy's Edge: Black Spire]]'' occuring a few months prior.</ref> There, she acted as air support should any First Order [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighters]] attack their hidden base.<ref name="Rise" />
Later that year, [[Vi Moradi]] drummed up enough new recruits that local command decided to fly the group to General Organa's secret base on [[Pacara]]. Blue Five joined the mission with [[Red Two (Batuu)|Red Two]] to escort an [[Intersystem Transport Ship]] carrying the new volunteers. The three ships along with [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] in the lead took off from the [[Black Spire Ruins]] and flew into orbit.<ref name="Rise" />

Before they could escape through [[Hyperspace]], their group was attacked by a flurry of TIE fighters launched from two [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|Resurgent-class Star Destroyers]] hidden in orbit, including Kylo Ren's personal flagship, the [[Finalizer]]. She leapt into action, gunning down a few TIEs as she twisted through Batuu's [[asteroid field]]; however, they were quickly overwhelmed, and the TIEs shot down her wingmate, Red Two. Blue Five took evasive action, but there were too many of them. She [[Death|died]] defending the transport when her fighter was destroyed.<ref name="Rise" />

While she and Red Two perished in the skirmish, they bought Poe Dameron time to jump to hyperspace to scramble reinforcements. He brought back a small fleet of Resistance capital ships to engage the Star Destroyers while the new recruits successfully met up with [[Finn]] aboard the Destroyer and escaped with valuable intelligence.<ref name="Rise" />

==Behind the Scenes==
[[File:Connix_last_transport.png|left|thumb|Red Two and Blue Five reused Last Jedi helmets]]
Blue Five first appeared in {{GEAttr|Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance|Rise of the Resistance}} on [[December 5]], [[2019]] in [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]] and [[January 17]], [[2020]]<ref name="DPB-#DisneyParksLIVE: Watch the Dedication of Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance">{{DPB|url=2019/12/disneyparkslive-watch-the-dedication-of-rise-of-the-resistance-live-on-dec-4|text=#DisneyParksLIVE: Watch the Dedication of Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance}}</ref> The helmet worn by Blue Five was reused from another Resistance pilot in ''[[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi]]''.<ref name="TLJ" /> The [[Aurebesh]] writing on the pilot's flight suit states "Pull to inflate," written upside down for the wearer to read, as the vest also acted as a flotation device.<ref name="Rise" />
